name: Field
purpose: Wire one form control to its label, description, error, and shared required, disabled, read-only, and invalid state.
useWhen: One control needs a visible label and may need help or error text.

avoidWhen.condition: Several related controls share one group label.
avoidWhen.useInstead: Fieldset containing one Field per control when needed

composition: Compose Field.Root -> Field.Label -> one Field-aware control -> optional Field.Description -> optional Field.Error.

rules.statement: Associate one Field with one owned control.
Field.Label already renders the default required marker; do not add Field.RequiredIndicator inside it unless the default indicator is disabled.
Make error text explain how to correct the value.

commonMistakes.mistake: Adding a manual asterisk or RequiredIndicator beside the default required Label.
commonMistakes.correction: Set required on Field.Root and let Field.Label render its built-in marker, or disable that marker before composing a separate indicator.

validation: Confirm description and visible error IDs appear in aria-describedby.
Confirm exactly one required indicator is visible.
